excerpts.content:
<@119818938845495298> <@543900561460822016> any appetite for restarting the Native Account Abstraction call on a regular cadence? There has only been the one back in April.

There is enough implementation work across the proposals now that a standing slot would beat pulling it into ACD. I am happy to facilitate if you would rather not, or to share it.

Bi-weekly seems about right, but no strong opinion.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: yeah i think we're at the point where that would be useful
